events.what_it_is: A café-inspired CHANEL fragrance experience celebrating COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, hair and body products, makeup and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance experience are free. Products are available to explore; purchases are optional.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional, not a prerequisite or approval step.
events.practical_notes: September 11 and 18: noon–7 PM. September 12–13 and 19–20: 10 AM–7 PM at 873 Washington Street.

events.event_name: DISCOVER SHIYENZE | Fashion Week Open Atelier
events.what_it_is: A three-day open atelier with Shiyenze Fashion, featuring the collection, one-of-one pieces, styling, designer conversation, Kenyan tea and wine.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free with RSVP; shopping is optional.
events.caveats: Eventbrite lists this as free with RSVP. No organizer-approval language is shown in the verified listing.
events.practical_notes: Friday opening night 5–9 PM; Saturday open atelier 12–8 PM; Sunday 12–6 PM. Shiyenze's own site independently confirms its New York location at 87 George Street.

events.event_name: Ready, Set, Serve: A US Open Fan Experience
events.what_it_is: A US Open fan experience with an immersive tennis photo booth and public finals livestreams, plus a September 13 celebration with DJ, drinks and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Public photo-booth access and finals viewing are advertised; September 13 also includes drinks and giveaways while available.
events.caveats: No advance RSVP or approval requirement is stated in the current listing. Giveaways and drinks are promotional and should not be treated as guaranteed for every attendee.
events.practical_notes: Women's Doubles Final livestream September 11 at noon; Men's Doubles Final September 12 at noon; Women's Singles Final September 12 at 4 PM; Men's Singles Final celebration September 13 at 2 PM.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public Mary Kay beauty activation built around the brand's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product giveaways, touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skin-care products plus beauty touch-ups; promotional inventory is finite.
events.caveats: Multiple current event sources agree that this is free and open to the public. No RSVP or approval requirement is published. Giveaway quantities are limited even though one current listing advertises a large product allotment.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from noon–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort Street.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling and sweet treats are advertised as part of the public activation; exact quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current independent event listings agree that the activation is open to the public. No RSVP or approval requirement is published. Samples and treats are promotional inventory and may run out.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from noon–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo.
